fields.description: What the inspector is being asked. Written as a thing that can be true or false on site.
fields.label: Check

fields.description: The standard it passes against. If this cannot be written, the check cannot be inspected.
fields.label: Acceptance criteria

fields.description: How it is verified — visually, with an instrument, by a document, by a signature.
fields.label: Verification method

fields.description: A mandatory row must be answered before the inspection can be submitted.
fields.label: Mandatory

fields.description: Tick where the evidence matters more than the answer — remote work, subcontracted work, anything that gets covered up.
fields.label: Photo required

fields.description: Answers offered for this row, one per line. Blank means Pass / Fail / N/A. Per-row rather than a Select on the result, because a Select cannot vary its options by row — the same reason Sapphire Maintenance stores its answer as Data.
fields.label: Answer options

fields.description: Stable identity for this check, minted once and never regenerated. A generated inspection refers back to it by key, so reordering or rewording a row never repoints a recorded result.
fields.label: Item key

fields.description: The code, spec or SOP clause this check enforces, if there is one.
fields.label: Reference standard
